# Elixir system

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** buff, uptime

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. General elixir system: enabled elixirs grant player-wide buffs scaled by Elixir Effect (full uptime); Tailored Remedy gate; Total Elixir Effect panel.

## Implementation (engine model)

`elixir_resolver.py::resolve_elixirs` parses each enabled elixir skill (`elixir` tag, `active_skill`) `detailed_description` through the shared `parse_mod` pipeline into UNSCALED buffs emitted as the SAME typed/scoped stats auras use (so offense's conversion-aware stage handles them). `utility.py::apply_elixir_buffs` scales each buff by Elixir Effect `= (1+Σ elixir_effect_inc)×(1+Σ elixir_effect_additional)`; buffs flagged `no_scale` (`_NO_SCALE_KEYS`: `lucky_*`, `es_uninterruptible`, `es_bypass_pct`) skip the scale. Uptime assumed 100% while enabled; disabled elixirs are resolved for display but not folded. `has_blur` gates lines on `blur_active` (server auto-sets from Putrid Toad). Restoration tonic lines (`Restores N% Max Life/Mana within Ns`, level-interpolated via `(LvN:…)` anchors) become structured `restoration` entries fed to `recovery.py` (× Elixir Effect/Duration, then Restoration Effect/Duration). Licorice Note ingredients fold in as buffs; Pixie Tear's `excess_restoration_to_es_pct` + `dmg_additional_per_400_es` (+cap) handled explicitly, `no_scale`. Support gems adjust charge/max-charge timing (display). Unmapped lines surface NYI. Real cooldown/charge uptime NYI.
